name: Goliath Crane
tagline: IS:3177 and IS:807 certified goliath crane for open yard heavy operations
description: Safe Build Engineering's Goliath Cranes are designed and manufactured in accordance with IS:3177 and IS:4137, with structural parts per IS:807. Applicable in construction, industry, yards, roadsides and other open areas, they are load tested to 125% and certified before dispatch.
features: High quality structural assembly per IS:4301
Squirrel cage induction motors with fail safe brakes
Built-in brakes for hoisting, cross travel and long travel

specs.Class of Duty: M5, M7, M8 as per IS 3177 / IS 807
specs.Crane Control: Pendant push buttons / Radio remote / Cabin with master control
specs.Drive System: Twin drive squirrel cage induction geared motors with fail safe brakes
specs.Power Supply: Trailing cables / drag chain / shrouded bus bars / cable reeling drum
